title: Nextblocks
body:
This is a goofy mod that adds blocky nextbots (AKA nextblocks) and other additions (including toilets and blocks of absolute cinema) to Minecraft. To find all these things in survival, I recommend crafting a nextfinder with a bottle o' enchanting and a block of redstone to get started!

_Note: This mod is still very new. Please report any bugs and/or make suggestions on [the issue tracker](https://github.com/MagentaDude/nextblocks/issues)._
